question_text: When should you use Server-Side Rendering (SSR) vs Static Site Generation (SSG) vs Client-Side Rendering?
answer: SSG fits marketing/documentation pages with rare updates, SSR handles SEO-sensitive dynamic content per request, and CSR powers interactive authenticated dashboards.

question_text: How do you maintain consistent styling and responsive breakpoints with Tailwind CSS?
answer: I configure semantic design tokens in the theme config, build reusable headless UI primitives, apply mobile-first utility classes (sm/md/lg), and verify dark/light mode contrast.

question_text: How do you make web forms accessible (a11y) for screen readers and keyboard users?
answer: I bind explicit label htmlFor attributes, add aria-live error regions, preserve logical tab focus order, support Enter/Escape modal shortcuts, and maintain WCAG color contrast.

question_text: How do you optimize frontend bundle size and Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP)?
answer: I use route-based code splitting and lazy loading, reserve explicit image dimensions to eliminate layout shift, memoize heavy renders, and avoid blocking main-thread scripts.
